newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kobe rubber futures mixed in after-hours trade.
newsitem.headline: Kobe rubber futures mixed in after-hours trade.

text.p: Kobe rubber futures were mixed in thin after-hours trade on Monday after long-liquidation, especially in nearby months, pressured the market during the day, traders said.
Prices ranged from 0.3 yen per kg lower to 2.2 yen higher than the day's close. Benchmark March was 0.3 yen lower at 134.4 yen. Volume was small, with only 4,402 lots traded.
Activity was described as directionless and featureless.
"Most market players retreated to the sidelines, waiting for fresh factors to provide direction to the market," an analyst at a commodity broker said.
